name: sii-style-teacher-readout-8gpu
description: SII-style self-teacher phase B over the full multiselect train+dev: 8 transformers replicas (one P100/H100-class GPU each, Qwen3.5-4B bf16) read SII's answer-slot prompt after each phase-A reasoning chain, take the last-position hidden state, gather the 255 single-token label logits and compute per-option sigmoid q, averaged over chains; softmax is stored for comparison. CPU smoke on the base head shows the raw sigmoid can saturate (all label logits positive); inspect q_value_stats/per_chain_softmax and set Q_TRANSFORM=softmax if needed. Requires runs/qz/sii_style_teacher/reasoning/{train,dev}.jsonl from the generation job. Resumable per id; writes runs/qz/sii_style_teacher/q and data/multiselect/sii_teacher_{train,dev}.jsonl + sii_teacher_summary.json. CreateJob dry-run first; this payload is not submitted by the harness author.
command:
set -uo pipefail
R=/inspire/hdd/global_user/zhangjiaquan-253108540222/research/DiffRwkv/decision_compare
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
cd "$R"
mkdir -p "$R/logs/qz" "$R/runs/qz/sii_style_teacher"
REASONING=0 READOUT=1 SHARDS=8 SAMPLES=2 MAX_MODEL_LEN=8192 READOUT_BATCH=4 READOUT_MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=8192 Q_TRANSFORM=sigmoid DATA_DIR="$R/data/multiselect" RUN_ROOT="$R/runs/qz/sii_style_teacher" SUMMARY="$R/data/multiselect/sii_teacher_summary.json" LOG_DIR="$R/logs/qz" bash harness/run_sii_style_teacher.sh > "$R/logs/qz/sii_style_teacher_readout.log" 2>&1
status=$?
echo "JOB EXIT=$status"
exit $status
